build.buildCommand: bun install --no-save && bun --filter=@mercurjs/storefront run build && mkdir -p apps/storefront/.next/standalone/apps/storefront/public apps/storefront/.next/standalone/apps/storefront/.next/static && cp -a apps/storefront/public/. apps/storefront/.next/standalone/apps/storefront/public/ && cp -a apps/storefront/.next/static/. apps/storefront/.next/standalone/apps/storefront/.next/static/

deploy.startCommand: cd apps/storefront/.next/standalone && PORT=${PORT} HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 node apps/storefront/server.js
